g.text: Decode throughput across the revision ladder
Qwen3.8-27B IQ4_XS, RTX 5060 Ti, synthetic32, greedy decode
95% CI over three independent process means

rect.title: FlagMega / r002: Hypothesis never fixed: kernel expert proposed multi-nibble IQ4 decoding in the packed-word owner, pending decode/address/dot controls and issue data; no run was ever dispatched.

FlagMega / r005: Falsified at design: deleting all 96 observed internal launch gaps buys only 0.008928 ms, and deleting the gaps plus the entire Y stage still leaves +0.980513 / +1.341266 ms against the comparator; PDL does not publish dependent data earlier.

FlagMega / r006: Falsified at design: two-shared-packet staging needs 16384 B/CTA usable static while the r004 contract allows <=1024 B with zero dynamic shared. The route was revisited and landed as r031.
FlagMega / r007: Route closed at implementation: the bounded shared-staging envelope could not hold the required capacity at the declared thread count.
FlagMega / r008: Round r008: capacity could rise but the synchronisation cost rose faster; only GLU operator timing was taken.
FlagMega / r009: Round r009: transport ablation found native cp.async 22% faster than TMA into the same shared consumer.
FlagMega / r010: Round r010: per-PC shared wavefront excess brought to zero, but still 2.048 us slower than the plain kernel.
FlagMega / r011: Round r011: first real in-flight census; the blocking point is the empty/recycle barrier, not cp.async wait.
FlagMega / r012: Round r012: producer pipelining tested and excluded; globaltimer showed rows published before readers release.
FlagMega / r013: Round r013: cross-operator fusion gap measured as exactly 0.000000 us per layer, so it is not the loss.
FlagMega / r014: Round r014: burst length R=1/2/4/8 was non-monotonic, falsifying the burst-granularity hypothesis.
FlagMega / r015: Round r015: the persistent structure is 16.2% slower by itself; the megakernel route was closed here.
FlagMega / r016: Round r016: first strict standalone win after seventeen rounds, on plain MLP depth; magnitude small.
FlagMega / r017: Round r017: GDN PREP grid 48 -> 960 CTAs, 45.008000 -> 12.291467 us, 1.496218 ms over 48 layers.
FlagMega / r018: Round r018: independent K9 re-qualification closed R16 and refused to count R17 before its own K9.
FlagMega / r019: Round r019: R17 qualified 8/8 units on the complete P5 boundary with max U95 -27.029893 us.
FlagMega / r020: Round r020: padding saved and the slot path opened, but DRAM request continuity still failed.
FlagMega / r021: Round r021: the two full-grid barriers were removed, but the ending imbalance made total time slower.
FlagMega / r022: Round r022: full residency with an atomic work queue, but tail imbalance and DRAM both missed.
FlagMega / r023: Round r023: wide consumer with a fine queue; consumer count is not the bottleneck.
FlagMega / r024: Round r024: cross-layer megakernel made the boundary DRAM pass for the first time; the producer still stalled.
FlagMega / r025: Round r025: L2 prefetch at the boundary removed the stall, but the PF2 prefetch itself consumed the gain.
FlagMega / r026: Round r026: shared staging removed, 354.133406 GB/s, +10.456% over the plain kernel.
FlagMega / r027: Round r027: 40 registers, zero spill, 9 CTA/SM, 394.661133 GB/s, +4.715% over the plain kernel.
FlagMega / r028: Round r028: persistent grid parity; the small grid is 4.193% behind and the gap was localized.
FlagMega / r029: Round r029: shared load cut 95.75% with no bandwidth change; the cross-layer arithmetic is negative.
FlagMega / r030: Round r030: R27 independently qualified, 394.219079 GB/s, three seeds bitwise, 960 samples zero exclusion.

g.text: Points: full-model measurements only. Open squares: no full-model run at that step; the table states why. r008-r030 are the r006 rounds, measured at operator level.
H002: repeated IQ4 decode/address issue (never dispatched)
H004: P5 / GDN head by column
H005: programmatic launch overlap (falsified at design)
Capacity sweep: capacity rises, sync cost rises faster
cp.async is 22% faster than TMA on the same consumer
Wavefront excess zeroed; 2.048 us above plain baseline
First in-flight measurement; the empty/free barrier blocks
Producer pipelining excluded as the missing overlap
Cross-operator gap measured at 0.000 us per layer
Persistent structure itself 16.2% slower; route closed
First strict standalone win (plain MLP depth)
GDN PREP 45.008 -> 12.291 us, 1.496 ms over 48 layers
Independent re-qualification: R16 closed, R17 not counted
R17 QUALIFIED 8/8 on the full P5 boundary
Padding and slot fixed; DRAM continuity still fails
Barriers removed; tail imbalance makes it slower
Full residency reached; tail and DRAM both still miss
Consumer count is not the bottleneck (falsified)
Boundary DRAM passes; producer still stalls
Stall removed, PF2 prefetch eats the gain
Megakernel GLU first strictly beats the plain kernel
Small grid 4.193% behind; gap localized to one path
Shared round-trips are not that 4%; cross-layer negative
R27 GLU megakernel + R17 GDN PREP
